items.markdown:
Professional carpet cleaning in Melbourne typically costs `between $50 to $80 per room (or $3 to $5 per square metre)` . You can generally choose between hot water extraction (steam cleaning), which provides a deep sanitize, or low-moisture dry cleaning, which dries completely in just 1 to 2 hours.[](https://www.electrodry.com.au/carpet-cleaning-melbourne/) [[1]](https://www.electrodry.com.au/carpet-cleaning-melbourne/)[[2]](https://rightpricecarpetcleaning.com.au/carpet-cleaning-prices-melbourne/)[[3]](https://wdcfacilityservices.com.au/carpet-cleaning-service-cost-in-melbourne/)[[4]](https://www.carpetcleanersmelbourne.com.au/)[[5]](https://www.bisekinteriors.com/blog/articles/steam-cleaning-vs-shampooing-which-carpet-cleaning-method-is-right-for-you)

Top-rated, local Melbourne companies offering both steam and dry cleaning options:

**1. Electrodry Carpet Dry Cleaning** 

- **Specialty:** Low-moisture dry cleaning process designed for Melbourne’s unpredictable weather, allowing carpets to be walk-on dry in 1 to 2 hours.
- **Contact:** 13 27 13
- **Booking:** Explore options or book a service via [Electrodry Carpet Cleaning Melbourne](https://www.electrodry.com.au/carpet-cleaning-melbourne/).[[1]](https://www.electrodry.com.au/carpet-cleaning-melbourne/)

**2. The Squeaky Clean Team** 

- **Specialty:** IICRC-certified technicians specializing in tough stain removal (wine, coffee, pet accidents) and emergency 24/7 water damage restoration.
- **Contact:** 1300 682 563
- **Booking:** Get a quote and check availability at [The Squeaky Clean Team](https://squeakycleanteam.com.au/).[[1]](https://squeakycleanteam.com.au/)

**3. Jim’s Carpet Cleaning** 

- **Specialty:** One of Australia's most established franchises offering deeply hygienic cleaning services. They are fully insured, police-checked, and backed by the "Jim’s Work Guarantee".
- **Contact:** 131 546
- **Booking:** Book online or learn more at [Jim's Carpet Cleaning Services in Melbourne](https://jimscleaning.com.au/local/carpet-cleaning/vic/melbourne/melbourne+3000/).[[1]](https://jimscleaning.com.au/local/carpet-cleaning/vic/melbourne/melbourne+3000/)[[2]](https://www.jimscarpetcleaning.com.au/business-opportunities/)

**4. Chem-Dry Metro** 

- **Specialty:** Award-winning, family-owned local business that uses eco-friendly, non-toxic, and wool-safe solutions. Fast drying times (1-2 hours) thanks to minimal water usage.
- **Booking:** Request a consultation at [Professional Speciality Cleaning & Restoration Melbourne](https://www.carpetcleanersmelbourne.com.au/).[[1]](https://www.carpetcleanersmelbourne.com.au/)

**Key Considerations:** 

- **Method:** Steam cleaning is better for heavily soiled or allergy-prone homes, but requires 12–24 hours to fully dry. Dry cleaning is faster and ideal for regular maintenance.
- **Minimum Call-Outs:** Most Melbourne cleaners require a minimum call-out fee (usually around $120 to $150).[](https://www.electrodry.com.au/carpet-cleaning-melbourne/) [[1]](https://www.electrodry.com.au/carpet-cleaning-melbourne/)[[2]](https://www.bisekinteriors.com/blog/articles/steam-cleaning-vs-shampooing-which-carpet-cleaning-method-is-right-for-you)[[3]](https://oldworldrestorationandcarpetcleaning.com/professional-vs-diy-carpet-cleaning-a-cost-comparison/)[[4]](https://squeakycleanteam.com.au/)
